status: First-release scope resolved; implementation and numerical export pending
scope: Step 3 only; records definitions and deferrals without generating dashboard data or changing source packages.

institution_profiles.period_label: Period-standardized profiles, with equal weighting of 2010–2016 and 2017–2023
institution_profiles.coverage_policy: Display earlier/later work counts as context; do not apply their period as a profile filter or multiply profile rows through a one-to-many join.
institution_profiles.point_policy: Preserve supported finite estimates even when their reportable intervals are unavailable. Use unit_id rather than the partially blank embedded institution_id.
institution_profiles.interval_policy: Display only the saved reportable profile intervals; preserve their statuses. Diagnostic bounds do not fill missing bounds.
institution_profiles.interpretation: Period-standardized fitted profiles retain degree and field composition. They are not observed period-specific proportions, institutional quality rankings or causal effects.

institution_benchmark.display_label: Average fitted profile (50 institutions, equal weights)

cohort.fingerprint_encoding: Sorted IDs, UTF-8, LF separators, terminal LF
cohort.membership: The fixed T12 institutional roster selected before outcome-specific exclusions; identical for all four outcomes.

eligibility_validation: T12 profile_supported=1 for all 50 roster members within each outcome.
One T10 row per roster institution, outcome and category, with report_supported=1 and finite probability estimate.
Interval availability is not a point eligibility condition.
institution_benchmark.weighting: 1/50 per institution; use supplied period-standardized estimates without refitting or reweighting by work counts.
institution_benchmark.invariance: Institution selection and category visibility never change membership, weights or benchmark values; selected institutions remain in the reference.
institution_benchmark.uncertainty_rule: No benchmark confidence interval, significance test, or difference interval is supported by marginal profile intervals; do not average their endpoints.
institution_benchmark.missing_input_policy: Mark the affected outcome/category benchmark unavailable if any fixed member lacks a valid supported point. Do not drop members, fill zero or silently reselect/reweight the cohort; require explicit scope/version revision.
institution_benchmark.multi_response_rule: C8 categories are nonexclusive; do not renormalize their means to sum to 100%.
institution_benchmark.build_status: Defined here; no benchmark values generated in step 3.

institution_observed_period_profiles.reason: The existing package has period-specific coverage but no institution-period-category numerator table. The first release uses saved fitted profiles instead.
reentry_requirements: Prepare and review actual institution-period-category counts and eligible bases.
Define the observed estimand and fixed cohort explicitly before changing the fitted view.

employment_training_linked.reason: Released degree-role and research-content margins do not supply their joint cells.
reentry_requirements: Construct reviewed joint aggregates for one broad field OR content subgroup.
Document observation/scoring bases, missingness, support and disclosure limits.
Do not infer intersections from marginal tables or enable combined field-and-content filters.

funding_bands_extension.reason: The funding measure, band boundaries and supported joint comparison populations have not been defined for this extension.
reentry_requirements: Choose the measure, units, fiscal/completion windows and band boundaries.
Specify the joint population, treatment of zeros/missingness and any overlapping exposure.
Prepare and validate the required aggregates; keep project-count exposures distinct from dollar amounts.

interface_rules: Do not expose deferred views as operational filters or allow their states through a shared URL.
Remove or disable institution period/degree/field controls only for the fitted institutional view; keep supported period controls in other mapped views.
Institution search changes visible selections, not the fixed cohort.
Keep the complete released table catalog available; deferral does not remove evidence downloads.
